api.name: convohop
api.summary: ConvoHop communication plane (conversations, messages, realtime events and live sessions) and management plane (organizations, deployments and projects).

errors.summary: GraphQL errors carry these extensions. Classify errors by extensions, never by message text. Errors may arrive with HTTP 200.

outcome.summary: rejected: the request did not commit. unknown: it may have committed; resolve or retry it with the same requestId.

retryable.summary: Whether a later attempt with the same requestId may succeed.

communication.summary: Conversations, members, messages, receipts, realtime events and live sessions inside one project.

rules.summary: Communication requests always name their project explicitly.
Copy incarnation and servingEpoch from the current signed route. Stale values fail with INCARNATION_MISMATCH or WRONG_REGION.
Delivery permits authorize only credential redemption and acknowledgement.

management.summary: Organizations, deployments, projects, backend keys and webhooks.

rules.summary: Management operations select projects through operation input.
Delivery permits never authorize management operations.

Decimal.summary: Non-negative 64-bit counter as a canonical decimal string. Never convert it to a floating-point number.

Properties.summary: Application-defined JSON object. Numbers must stay within the interoperable safe-integer range.

SignedProof.summary: Server-signed JSON object. Treat it as opaque and pass it back unchanged.

UUID.summary: Canonical lowercase UUID. The nil UUID is rejected.

backendKey.summary: Scoped project backend key. Server runtimes only; never ship it to clients.

deliveryPermit.summary: Signed permit from management.credentialPermit, sent in the request context of a request without a bearer token.

portalCredential.summary: Operator credential for the management plane. Server runtimes only.

userSession.summary: Short-lived user session token that your backend obtains with issueSession. Safe for client runtimes.

callManage.summary: Read, alert and end any live session in the project.

callRead.summary: Read any live session in the project, with its participants and operations.

conversationManage.summary: Create, read and update any conversation in the project.

historyManage.summary: Expand the history visible to members.

membershipManage.summary: Read and change conversation membership and broadcast permissions.

messageRead.summary: Read history, get messages and search in any conversation of the project, or read as the member named by actAsPrincipalId. The inbox requires actAsPrincipalId. Requests that use actAsPrincipalId are audited.

messageWrite.summary: Send messages as the backend's service principal, or as the member named by actAsPrincipalId. Requests that use actAsPrincipalId are audited.

sessionManage.summary: Revoke user sessions and inspect session request outcomes.

authorOrModerator.summary: The caller wrote the message or moderates the conversation.

creatorOrModerator.summary: The caller started the live session or moderates its conversation.

member.summary: The caller is an active member of the conversation.

operationParticipant.summary: The caller started the operation or can access its target.

ownRequest.summary: The caller made the original request.

ownSession.summary: The session belongs to the caller.

owner.summary: The caller owns the organization, deployment or project.

participant.summary: The caller holds the referenced participation in the live session.

safe.summary: Read-only. Repeat freely; each attempt may use a new requestId.

idempotent.summary: Retry with the same requestId and identical input within the retry budget. The authority deduplicates by requestId; resolve an unknown outcome with resolveRequest.

singleUse.summary: Like idempotent, but the result carries a short-lived credential for one connection. Request a new one instead of reusing an expired result.

permitBound.summary: Authorized by a single-delivery permit. Retry with the same requestId and permit; outcomes cannot be resolved by lookup.

ephemeral.summary: Transient signal. Not deduplicated or retried; send a fresh signal instead.

cursor.summary: Server-ordered pages. Pass nextCursor back as the cursor input until complete is true.

sequence.summary: Newest first. Pass nextCursor back as the sequence cursor input to read older items until complete is true.

replay.summary: Committed events in ascending sequence after a cursor. Persist the last applied cursor; invalid or expired cursors fail and are never reset silently.

bounded.summary: One bounded page without a cursor input. complete reports whether every item fit.

ADMISSION_LIMIT.summary: A rate, size or concurrency admission limit was reached. Back off, then retry with the same requestId.

ALREADY_CONNECTED.summary: The participation already has an active media connection.

ALREADY_EXISTS.summary: A resource with the same unique key already exists.

AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE.summary: The authority is temporarily unavailable. Retry with the same requestId.

CREDENTIAL_DELIVERY_EXPIRED.summary: The credential delivery expired or can no longer be redeemed.

CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED.summary: The credential carried by the stored result has expired. Request a new one.

CREDENTIAL_REFRESH_REQUIRED.summary: The media credential must be refreshed before connecting.

CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED.summary: Delivery-permit requests cannot be resolved by lookup. Obtain a current permit and resubmit the same delivery explicitly.

CURSOR_AHEAD.summary: The cursor is ahead of the committed events of the conversation.

CURSOR_EXPIRED.summary: The cursor is older than retained history. Resynchronize from current state; never reset the cursor silently.

CURSOR_INVALID.summary: The cursor is malformed or was not issued for this query.

CURSOR_MISMATCH.summary: The cursor does not continue the subscribed stream.

CURSOR_SCOPE_MISMATCH.summary: The cursor was issued for a different scope, caller or visibility.

DELIVERY_CONSUMED.summary: The delivery was already redeemed by a different request.

DELIVERY_NOT_REDEEMED.summary: The delivery must be redeemed before it can be acknowledged.

DEPLOYMENT_NOT_READY.summary: The deployment cannot host projects yet.

FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED.summary: The feature is not available in this deployment.

FORBIDDEN.summary: The credential is valid but not allowed to perform this operation.

GENERATION_CONFLICT.summary: The live session generation changed. Read the current generation and retry.

GRAPHQL_ERROR.summary: A GraphQL error arrived without a recognized code.

GRAPHQL_INVALID_REQUEST.summary: The GraphQL request is malformed or fails validation.

GRAPHQL_QUERY_LIMIT.summary: The GraphQL document exceeds a depth, complexity or size limit.

GRAPHQL_RESPONSE_LIMIT.summary: The query response exceeds the response limit. Request a smaller page.

HTTP_FAILURE.summary: The HTTP exchange failed without a usable GraphQL error.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.summary: The requestId was already used with a different payload or caller.

INCARNATION_MISMATCH.summary: The project incarnation changed. Discard state from the old incarnation and recover explicitly.

INVALID_REPLACEMENT.summary: The connection to replace is not a current connection of this participation.

INVALID_REQUEST.summary: The input or request context failed validation.

INVALID_RESPONSE.summary: The response did not match the expected shape or identity. The outcome is unknown.

LIVE_ALERT_LIMIT.summary: The live session reached its alert limit.

LIVE_SESSION_CLOSED.summary: The live session has ended or is ending.

LIVE_SESSION_EXISTS.summary: The conversation already has an active live session.

MEDIA_CONNECT_FAILED.summary: The native media connection failed. The participation remains; resolve and reconnect, or leave explicitly.

MEDIA_FENCE_REQUIRED.summary: Media cutoff is not enforced yet for this live session. Retry after the cutoff completes.

MEDIA_NOT_READY.summary: Media for the live session is not ready yet.

MEDIA_RECOVERING.summary: Media for the live session is recovering.

MEMBER_LIMIT.summary: The conversation reached its member limit.

NOT_A_SESSION_REQUEST.summary: The requestId does not belong to an issueSession or renewSession request.

NOT_FOUND.summary: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.summary: The mutation may have committed. Retry with the same requestId or resolve it.

PAGE_ITEM_TOO_LARGE.summary: A single item exceeds the page response limit.

PARTICIPATION_MISMATCH.summary: The participation does not belong to the caller or the current live session generation.

PERMIT_EXPIRED.summary: The stored delivery permit has expired. Request a new permit.

RECOVERY_STORAGE_FAILURE.summary: Caller-provided recovery storage did not confirm durability. Keep the original request and its outcome.

REQUEST_EXPIRED.summary: The original request is too old to replay.

REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.summary: The request body exceeds the size limit.

RESOLUTION_REQUIRED.summary: The outcome is still unresolved and the retry budget is spent. Resolve the original request before continuing.

RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE.summary: The response exceeds the size limit.

RESYNC_REQUIRED.summary: The subscription cannot continue. Replay from the last applied cursor.

RETRY_EXHAUSTED.summary: The authority exhausted its internal retry budget. Retry later with the same requestId.

REVISION_CONFLICT.summary: The expected revision or epoch is stale. Read the current state and retry with a new request.

SCOPE_REQUIRED.summary: The backend key lacks a scope this operation requires. The message names the scope.

SESSION_RECEIPT_BINDING_MISMATCH.summary: The stored session receipt does not match its binding.

SESSION_RECEIPT_INVALID.summary: The stored session receipt failed validation.

SESSION_REFRESH_FAILED.summary: The application session refresh callback failed.

SESSION_REFRESH_REJECTED.summary: The refreshed session was rejected because it does not match the current session.

SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED.summary: The user session needs renewal and no refresh is configured, or it expired.

SESSION_REFRESH_UNVERIFIED.summary: The refreshed session could not be verified.

TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN.summary: The transport failed after the request may have been sent. Resolve or retry the original request.

UNAUTHENTICATED.summary: The credential is missing, invalid or expired.

WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT.summary: The project reached its webhook endpoint limit.

WRONG_REGION.summary: The observed serving epoch is stale. Route again, then retry.

http.summary: Request and response handling over HTTP.

live.summary: Operations on an existing live session.

conversationEvents.summary: Ordered events of one conversation over graphql-transport-ws, gap-filled with the replay query.
conversationEvents.ordering: Events arrive in ascending sequence per conversation. Apply each page, then persist its nextCursor; resume after the last applied cursor.

conversation.updated.summary: A conversation's title or properties changed.
conversation.updated.subject: conversation

live.alerted.summary: Members were alerted about a live session.
live.alerted.subject: liveSession

live.participationChanged.summary: A participant joined or left a live session.
live.participationChanged.subject: liveSession

live.ready.summary: A live session became ready for media.
live.ready.subject: liveSession

member.broadcastPermissionChanged.summary: A member's live session broadcast permission changed.
member.broadcastPermissionChanged.subject: member

member.historyExpanded.summary: A member's visible history was expanded.
member.historyExpanded.subject: member

receipt.reported.summary: A member reported delivery or read progress.
receipt.reported.subject: member

communication.capabilities.summary: Describe the features, limits and API model the authority supports.

communication.route.summary: Return the signed route: project incarnation, serving epoch and realtime endpoint. Call it before other communication operations and again after WRONG_REGION.

communication.members.summary: List the members of a conversation.

communication.messages.summary: List the messages of a conversation, newest first. A backend key reads the full history, or the history visible to the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

communication.getMessage.summary: Read one message. A backend key reads any message, or reads as the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

communication.events.summary: Replay committed conversation events after a cursor, in sequence order.

communication.receipts.summary: List the delivery and read receipts of a conversation.

communication.inbox.summary: List the conversations visible to the calling user. A backend key must name that user with actAsPrincipalId.

communication.search.summary: Search the messages visible to the calling user. A backend key searches as the member named by actAsPrincipalId, or within scope.conversationIds.

communication.resolveRequest.summary: Look up the stored outcome of an earlier communication mutation by its requestId.

communication.getOperation.summary: Read the state of a long-running communication operation.

communication.currentLiveSession.summary: Return the active live session of a conversation, if any.

communication.liveSessions.summary: List the live sessions of a conversation.

communication.liveSessionParticipants.summary: List the participants of a live session.

communication.liveSessionAlerts.summary: List the live session alerts addressed to the calling user.

communication.liveSessionOperation.summary: Read the state of a live session start or end operation.

communication.sessionRequestOutcome.summary: Look up the outcome of an earlier issueSession or renewSession request, including the session it produced.

communication.createPrincipal.summary: Create a principal for an application user.

communication.issueSession.summary: Issue a short-lived user session token for a principal and device.

communication.renewSession.summary: Renew a user session before it expires.

communication.createConversation.summary: Create a conversation with its initial members.

communication.updateConversation.summary: Update the title or properties of a conversation.

communication.addMember.summary: Add a member, or change the role of an active member.

communication.addMembers.summary: Add several members in one request.

communication.removeMember.summary: Remove a member from a conversation.

communication.historyGrant.summary: Expand the history a member can see to an earlier sequence.

communication.sendMessage.summary: Send a message. A backend key sends as its service principal, or as the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

communication.reportReceipt.summary: Report delivery or read progress through a sequence.

communication.setBroadcastPermission.summary: Allow or deny a member to publish media in live sessions.

communication.startLiveSession.summary: Start a live session (a call) in a conversation. Readiness completes asynchronously.

communication.alertLiveSession.summary: Alert (ring) conversation members about a live session.

communication.endLiveSession.summary: End a live session for every participant. Completes asynchronously.

communication.liveSessionCredentials.summary: Obtain a media credential for one connection of the caller's participation.

communication.redeemCredential.summary: Redeem a delivered credential with its delivery permit.

communication.acknowledgeCredential.summary: Acknowledge that a redeemed credential is stored, closing the delivery.

communication.conversationEvents.summary: Subscribe to conversation events in sequence order, resuming after a cursor.

management.capabilities.summary: Describe the management features and limits the authority supports.

management.organizations.summary: List the organizations the caller can access.

management.deploymentHealth.summary: Read the health of a deployment.

management.deploymentUsage.summary: Read the metered usage of a deployment, summed over its projects. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.

management.projectUsage.summary: Read the metered usage of a project. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.

management.organizationUsage.summary: Read the metered usage of an organization in any status, summed over its projects. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.

management.webhookDeliveries.summary: List recent deliveries of a webhook endpoint.

management.resolveRequest.summary: Look up the stored outcome of an earlier management mutation by its requestId.

management.getOperation.summary: Read the state of a long-running management operation.

management.createDeployment.summary: Create a deployment in an organization. Completes asynchronously.

management.createProject.summary: Create a project in a ready deployment. Completes asynchronously.

management.issueBackendKey.summary: Issue a scoped backend key. The secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.

management.revokeBackendKey.summary: Revoke a backend key, optionally revoking the sessions it issued.

management.projectPolicy.summary: Change the policy of a project.

management.credentialPermit.summary: Issue a signed permit that authorizes redeeming one credential delivery.

management.configureWebhook.summary: Create a webhook endpoint for project events. The signing secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.
